Yes

Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I should go see what Kaito has to say
about this. I'm worried about him...

I wonder if Kaito's okay...
I hope he's feeling a little better.
<CLT=cltMIND>Right as I was about to ring the bell...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click*

<CLT=cltMIND>The door to Kaito's room opened,
and out came...
Ah...Maki.
<CLT=cltMIND>Is she...mad?

O-Oh, hey bro...
Perfect timing.
I gotta apologize to you, too...

...He told me he was going to skip today's
training, too.
So...he still doesn't feel well.

It's pathetic, but...I haven't been able to 
eat or sleep much since yesterday.

I think I'll get better if...I just rest 
a little longer, y'know?

Yeah...sure, Kaito.
Do what you have to do.

We'd have to reschedule our training 
sessions either way, come to think of it...

The student council said being out after 
nighttime was prohibited, right?
Well...

If you're feeling sick, that's one thing. But I
don't want you to change the training schedule.
You don't...need to do that.
R-Really? But—

I don't want to skip it, so it'll just be
the two of us training today.
What? Really?
...You don't want to?
...Do you want to die?
D-Die!?

Oh, sorry... That's an old habit.
Just pretend you didn't hear that.
<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't know such a "habit" existed...
Anyway...I don't want to give up now.

I've finally started to think about...how
I can confront it...
So...if I have to train alone, so be it.

...Maybe it's just because you're not feeling well,
but this is really unlike you, Kaito.

I never imagined that you would obey Angie.
I thought you did whatever you wanted.

Shuichi, I'm sorry, but...can I leave the 
training to you until I'm feeling better?
Of course, Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>I nodded firmly, then chased after
Maki and headed to the courtyard.
Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>You had...no one.

<CLT=cltMIND>You found out that awful truth
and gave up your life for Kirumi.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...I...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma, you wanted to fight with us,
didn't you?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that not enough reason to live?

<CLT=cltMIND>You could've fought with us, we could've
fought together...then you could have lived.
<CLT=cltMIND>We...couldn't have been your reason to live?
...Maybe I'm just being arrogant.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

Her scream of defiance.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps running isn't so bad...
Perhaps we aren't strong enough to face it.
